description: This file defines a MonoBehaviour component called FPSCounter for Unity that measures and displays the current Frames Per Second (FPS) in the game.

classes.name: FPSCounter
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that calculates and displays the current FPS in a Text UI component.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the FPS measurement timing and references the Text component.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Calculates the current FPS over a measurement period and updates the UI text.
